title: Cadence Mosaic — Preflight Runway Notebook
body:
Overview:
This working notebook collects the operational cadence, metric trackers, and gating checklist for the next feature launch (internal codename: Mosaic). Purpose is to centralize signals we will use during the 4-week preflight window and first 7 days post-launch. Use this doc as the single source for product-ops run-theater tasks; link into release readouts and SRE capacity pages for final signoff.

Primary objectives:
- Keep cross-team launch decisions data-driven: surface top-3 KPIs and failure modes every daily sync.
- Reduce false positives in rollback decisions by standardizing degradation thresholds and confirmation steps.
- Make staffing and escalation obvious (who does what at each time window).

Top-line KPIs (operational):
- Request success rate (p99 failure spikes): alert if 5%+ errors sustained for 10m. Owner: SRE.
- Median latency (user-critical path): target 180–220ms; degradation >30% triggers capacity probe. Owner: Serving Runtime.
- Cost per 1k generated tokens (hosted): monitor weekly; >15% delta vs baseline requires Optimize review. Owner: Finance/Product-ops.
- Model quality regressions: sample-based BLEU/ROUGE-like pass/fail on curated prompt set; fail = 3%+ drop in relevance score. Owner: Applied ML.
- Adoption funnel (feature opt-ins -> first usage): track 7-day conversion; flag if <60% of expected cohort. Owner: Growth/Product.

KPI tracker snapshot (week-over-week):
- Week -4 (prep): baseline metrics captured, canary prompts built, load tests scheduled.
- Week -2 (rehearse): 95th percentile latency under synthetic peak, rollback plan validated.
- Week 0 (launch): live telemetry dashboard, staff roster in place, fallback models warmed.

Weekly cadence (meetings and deliverables):
- Monday 09:30 PT — Preflight sync (30m): owners report delta vs baseline, blockers listed.
- Tuesday 11:00 PT — SRE capacity review (45m): synthetic-run results, autoscale policies, hot-cache plans.
- Wednesday 14:00 PT — Quality gate walk (30m): applied-ml shows evaluation on holdout prompts; product confirms acceptance criteria.
- Thursday 10:00 PT — Risk triage (ad-hoc if thresholds met) / otherwise async update.
- Friday 16:00 PT — Launch readiness snapshot (15m): single slide to exec queue.

Preflight checklist (operational steps, mark when complete):
- [ ] Baseline capture complete (traffic/latency/cost) — owner: Observability — target done by Week -4.
- [ ] Canary prompt set of 120 prompts, stratified by edge-cases — owner: Applied ML.
- [ ] Load test plan (30m ramp to 3x expected peak) — owner: Release Eng.
- [ ] Dedicated fallback model deployed and smoke-tested — owner: Serving Runtime.
- [ ] Token-cost sensitivity run (batching + quantization variants) — owner: Optimize team.
- [ ] Dataflow and logging path validated to retention SLA — owner: Platform Eng.
- [ ] SLOs and alert thresholds codified in alerting playbook — owner: SRE.
- [ ] Oncall rotation confirmed with handover notes and escalation matrix — owner: Product-ops.
- [ ] Customer comms draft for beta cohort and public launch — owner: GTM.

Launch gating rules (how to decide go/no-go on launch day):
- Hard stop: sustained system error rate >5% for 10m or any data loss incident.
- Soft stop: persistent latency increase of >30% p50/p95 for 15m AND quality regression on curated set.
- Operational confirmation: all critical checkboxes above must be green and at least one rollback path validated.
- Stakeholder signoff: Product Lead + SRE lead + Applied ML lead must explicitly approve in the noon sync.

Escalation matrix (quick):
- Tier 1 (first 0–30m): oncall SRE and Release Eng handle transient failures. Communication: Slack #mosaic-launch and page the oncall.
- Tier 2 (30–120m): Eng lead + Product-ops coordinate mitigation; prepare hotfix or rollback. Notify customer success for impacted customers.
- Tier 3 (>120m or data loss): Exec escalation, open incident bridge, consider partial feature disable by region.

Runbook snippets (common ops actions):
- How to revert to fallback model: see linked_artifacts:github:pr/4532 for deployment steps. Quick commands included in SRE playbook.
- How to flush KV caches gracefully: staged invalidation starting with canary pool, then 10% increments every 5m.
- Token-cost mitigation emergency: reduce max_tokens to 50% and increase sampling temperature to preserve UX. Owner: Product-ops + Optimize.

Risks and mitigations (working log):
- Risk: Unexpected model hallucination in sensitive docs. Mitigation: add prompt-based safety filter in inference path; emergency blocklist in place.
- Risk: Autoscale flapping under bursty arrival. Mitigation: smoothing window + temporary static capacity bump for first 2h post-launch.
- Risk: GTM embargo slip where we need to push launch to a later time. Mitigation: preserve feature flag gating with immediate pause.

Open questions / notes to self:
- We still need clarity on exact burn-rate threshold that triggers finance review; ballpark: >40% above commit baseline triggers immediate review — confirm with Finance (Maya).
- Confirm whether Dedicated customers require a separate rollout checklist (private network constraints). Diego to confirm by Week -3.
- Consider adding a lightweight synthetic user journey that validates the combined latency + quality signal instead of tracking them separately.

Post-launch (first 7 days) checklist:
- Day 0–1: High-frequency telemetry (1m) for p50/p95, error rate, and conversions.
- Day 2–3: Evaluate sample quality; run automated A/B check between baseline and new model.
- Day 4–7: Cost stabilization window; apply cost-tuning recommendations and measure 7-day rolling averages.

Quick reference (who to ping):
- Product-ops lead: Riley Kapoor (owner).
- Observability: Maya Chen.
- Serving runtime: Lena Fischer.
- Applied ML / Quality: Diego Alvarez.
- SRE: oncall@sre.redwood (use pager if severity >= 2).

Next steps (before Week -2 rehearsal):
- Finish canary prompt set and tag examples by failure mode (boundary, hallucination, toxicity) — assigned Diego, due 2025-02-20.
- Schedule synthetic 3x peak test and confirm runbook commands — Release Eng to publish runbook by 2025-02-22.
- Finalize oncall roster and handover doc — Product-ops to circulate by 2025-02-24.

Notes on doc hygiene: this is intentionally informal — treat as the working ledger. When items are finalized, copy the relevant checklist fragments into the release-readiness slide deck for archive. For any changes to gating thresholds, update linked_artifacts:confluence:PRODOPS-234 with rationale and timestamped approvals.

Revision history:
- 2025-02-12: initial draft (Riley)
- 2025-02-18: added KPI thresholds and runbook snippets (Maya, Diego)
- 2025-03-04: updated staffing roster and final gating rules after leadership review (Lena)
